GPT-6 Astra

OpenAI·Sep 2, 2026·12 harness configurations

GPT-6 Astra's best observed ARC-AGI-3 Semi-Private result with the Standard harnessStandard harness enables a model to carry forward notes it chooses to keep with it throughout the environment. was 62.7% at max reasoning for $26,098. With the Provider Adapter harnessThe Provider Adapter harness preserves opaque reasoning state between requests and uses compaction for longer conversations, allowing the model to reuse prior work., its best observed result was 99.9% at high reasoning for $18,817. Read more in our blog post, OpenAI's GPT-6 Astra on ARC-AGI-3.
